description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractCommandStrategy that implements command handling logic for persistent actors, including methods for applying commands, calculating metadata, and handling unhandled commands.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing command strategy logic for persistent actors, parameterized by command, entity, context, and result types.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a command within a given context and entity, performing null checks, logging, and delegating to doApply or unhandled.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Abstract method to calculate metadata based on the entity and command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the command strategy after applicability is determined.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Throws an IllegalArgumentException indicating the command is unhandled.

methods.name: getMatchingClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the command this strategy matches.

methods.name: getEntityOrThrow
methods.description: Utility method to return the entity or throw if null.

methods.name: getEventTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as an Instant.
